behaviour_not_bound.text: R raised its validated cli_abort ('Method "wald_asym" not implemented for `phylo_signal`.') and Julia raised MethodError, but the Julia error is structural, not the same refusal. The *_wald_ci function takes no method keyword, so the call raises MethodError for every method value, including a valid one, while R's error fires only for a method outside its supported set. The harness has no valid-method control, and inference-batch-contract-p1.json known_findings.derived_quantity_reject_spec_defect_reason records that no Julia call this comparand can run against exists for these quantities. A MethodError counting as the same error class is not signed under itchyshin/GLLVModels.jl#684 item 2.
